name: Mephtetramine
summary: There is limited information on the substance while additionally having conflicting reports. Some reports indicate the drug is inactive, while others indicate the drug is active and bears effects such as talkativeness, euphoria, and mental stimulation.

helpfulLinks.title: TripSit Factsheet
helpfulLinks.description: Rapid harm-reduction summary and combination data

uses.en: It has appeared as a designer drug sold online, but reports disagree about whether it has any effect.
uses.zh: 它曾以設計藥物的形式在網路上販售，但關於它是否有作用，各方報告並不一致。
uses.zhHans: 它曾以设计药物的形式在网络上贩售，但关于它是否有作用，各方报告并不一致。

fact.en: Mephtetramine, or MTTA, is built on a tetralone, a ring system in which a benzene ring is fused to a six-carbon ring carrying a ketone group.
fact.zh: Mephtetramine（MTTA）以四氫萘酮為骨架，這種環系是由苯環與一個帶酮基的六碳環融合而成。
fact.zhHans: Mephtetramine（MTTA）以四氢萘酮为骨架，这种环系是由苯环与一个带酮基的六碳环融合而成。
